Wingless.mechanism: Same five bins/four channels/three states per node. Build one public (node,role)->edge-index, encode src/dst bits once per edge, cache public lookahead by (edge,next-role), count extra indexing/caching memory and operations. Compare original frozen V checksum weights [1,2,3,4] with single predeclared alternate [1,3,4,2] modulo five. Pick checksum solely on FIT paired accuracy; tie-break original. DEV only after selection.
Wingless.verification: Raw logits and predictions of cached-primary MUST equal untouched V on every FIT and DEV public graph (no changed numerical operation order) or fail.
Wingless.cost: Count index build scans, candidate edge inspections, one-time encoded bit reads, lookahead compatibility, peak cache entries including extra memory; DO NOT conflate old edge-scan proxy with new actual edge inspections; baseline must include fullscan lookups for comparator.

Yggdrasil.goal: Per-hop causal path survival and cumulative score drift: distinguish pruning, retained recall, terminal score calibration, and depth collapse.
Yggdrasil.trace: For both positive and negative graphs, snapshot role step, active/retained (public node, raw 16bit key, score), candidate count, evictions, max scores, mean look, centered increment min/max, terminal prediction. Exact independently verified forward logit and public operation counters must match frozen T/V before any scientific interpretation.
Yggdrasil.oracle_separation: Scorer ONLY recovers unique positive raw-key-consistent causal path from public graph using original symbolic admission, never passes oracle route to model; references are joined to emitted trace after model returns.
metrics: traces split by depth and predicted false negatives/positives
